technical-summary: RUM04 foundation: explicit canonical execution root for immutable native YAML snapshots; validates absolute UTF-8 roots before filesystem lookup and rejects embedded NULs. ABI43 parser fixture receives the same explicit root; registers the existing rad_core-linked fixture with CTest. Snapshot wire test now covers caller-selected root, mismatched root, relative/file/NUL roots. Focused build and tests are pending.
